data: You hurl mud at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing {dice} {type} damage on a hit. On a hit, the target adds -1 to its attack rolls for the rest of the encounter. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to hit. The target may take an action to remove any mud from its face, resetting the effect.
Brings down the energy of any Pokémon that have already used a move this turn.
Lowers the crowd meter by the number of Pokemon that raised the crowd meter this turn.
